instruction.name: vfrstp.h
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, find the first negative 16-bit element in `b`. Write its index into the lane of `a` selected by the first element of the corresponding lane of `c` modulo 8, or write the maximum valid index plus one if no such element exists. Other elements of `a` remain unchanged.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
